[quote=tan_srpka;60113685][b][i]SRPKA DECLARES WAR ON EDU[/i][/b]

The Khatun of Srpka, Alaqa II the Stoic, made a public appearance in front of a crowd of people from the capitol buildings front balcony, preparing to announce potentially heavy words to the public.

[i]Gentlemen. Ladies. Non-humans. I thank those that have come to listen to my words first-hand. I have important news to share with the world.

The Khanate of Srpka, in order to protect East Shamatine sovereignty, has decided to take arms against those in [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation], [nation]Bantarus[/nation], and [nation]Ekpatanus[/nation], for their aggression against Nestor-Staat and [nation]Enkia[/nation]. Their occupation of these territories is not to be allowed, and we urge all nations to take arms with us against the looming threat. Their reasoning for invasion is invalid and unjustified, not to mention there was no reason given as to why they invaded [nation]Enkia[/nation].

We shall not sit idly by as the EDU bullies and corrupts the nations around them. I am very aware of our rocky history with Hydronia. But I hope that we can, for once, not be divided and distracted on each other for the time being, and work with Karcovskie and Hydronia for the sake of the independence of East Shamat.

We are going to blockade and militarize the Shamatine Strait as well as part of our cause. We urge the world to not cross the Strait, as we will not hesitate to fire upon any and all ships that are not our own.[/i]

Essentially our battle plan in a nutshell
